$comment: RLP's orchestration ladder: which models orchestrate, and under what budgets.
Configuration, not code — edit it here, or with /setup, /rlp-config, /rlp-roles
and /models --pick in a session. `rlp ladder` prints what RLP actually resolved.
`brain` null and an empty `models` array mean 'no arms chosen yet'. RLP ships no
arms on purpose: a model ref only means something on a host that has that
provider, so /setup writes them from the endpoints you connected rather than
RLP guessing and failing at the worker.
routing.gate is how much RLP does on its own: 'hybrid' (laya, plus deterministic
fan-out signals when unsure) or 'laya' (the model alone) are the orchestrating
modes; 'direct' never orchestrates at all — every request is handled inline, the
decision model is never loaded, and the rest of this file simply stops being
consulted. Switch it with /direct on|off in a session, `rlp mode direct|full`
from a shell, or `rlp --direct` for one session without touching this file.
